action.objective: Complete broad depth-4 search over all legal moves to identify best candidates in this R+B+3P vs R+king endgame.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search, so candidate_moves must be []. Position: White Kg1, Rd7, Bf6, pawns a3,g2,g4,h4 vs Black Kf8, Re4. White is up a bishop; goal is to consolidate and avoid rook activity. Full root coverage at depth 4 within the 3000-node broad budget should reveal which move best limits Black counterplay.
